command:
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\"),p=require(\"path\");const root=p.resolve(\"targets\");const inputs=fs.readdirSync(root).sort().map(name=>({path:p.join(root,name),source:\"supplied-dossier\",...(name.startsWith(\"05\")||name.startsWith(\"07\")?{locale:\"vi\"}:{})}));inputs.push({uri:\"https://docs.example.invalid/guide.pdf\",source:\"09-media.md\",type:\"pdf\"},{uri:\"https://docs.example.invalid/video\",source:\"09-media.md\"});fs.mkdirSync(\"audit-evidence\");fs.writeFileSync(\"audit-evidence/config.json\",JSON.stringify({inputs,localRoots:[root],inventoryComplete:true,mode:\"full\",brandName:\"Independent synthetic scenarios\"},null,2));'
rtk proxy node \""'$(pwd)/.agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs" start "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/config.json" "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/collection"'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/{worked-review,quote-verification}.md
rtk proxy jq -c '.rules[]|[.id,.evaluation,.requiredEvidenceKinds]' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/rules/core.json
rtk proxy rg -n 'studySources|campaign-report' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/*.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/examples/worked-review.mjs
rtk proxy sed -n '390,435p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/measurement.md
rtk proxy jq -r '.rules|to_entries[]|[.key,(.value.evidenceKinds//.value.requiredEvidenceKinds//[]|join(\",\"))]|@tsv' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/rules/core.json
rtk proxy ls audit-evidence/collection"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy jq -c '.rules[]' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/rules/core.json
rtk proxy head -c 2300 audit-evidence/collection/evidence.jsonl
rtk proxy head -c 1400 audit-evidence/collection/inventory.jsonl"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy jq -r '.rules[]|[.ruleId,(.requiredEvidence|join(\",\"))]|@tsv' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/rules/core.json
rtk proxy rg -n 'kind|value' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/validate.mjs -e 'http-response' -e 'extracted-text'
rtk proxy rg -n 'http-status|redirect' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/checks.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sed -n '105,160p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/checks.mjs
rtk proxy rg -n 'http-response|byteLength|local-file' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/validate.mjs
rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/schemas/finding.schema.json
rtk proxy sed -n '65,125p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/measurement.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy rg -n -C 5 'Evidence value differs' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/*.mjs
rtk proxy rg -n 'render-with-measurements' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sed -i '' 's/kind,artifact,value,snapshotHash/kind,artifact,value,encoding:\"json\",snapshotHash/' audit-evidence/prepare.mjs
rtk proxy node audit-evidence/prepare.mjs
rtk proxy node \""'$(pwd)/.agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs" review "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/collection" "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/review.json" "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/reviewed" > audit-evidence/review-receipt.json
rtk proxy node "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs" validate "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/reviewed" > audit-evidence/validation.json
rtk proxy sed -n '"'247,265p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs
rtk proxy cat audit-evidence/reviewed/delivery-summary.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy rg -n 'output|directory|report.md' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/report.mjs | tail -25
rtk proxy jq '.coverage.dimensions,.coverage.states,.valid,.completionAllowed' audit-evidence/validation.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk proxy mkdir audit-evidence/measured
rtk proxy cp -R audit-evidence/reviewed/config.json audit-evidence/reviewed/run.json audit-evidence/reviewed/inventory.jsonl audit-evidence/reviewed/checks.jsonl audit-evidence/reviewed/evidence.jsonl audit-evidence/reviewed/evidence audit-evidence/reviewed/findings.json audit-evidence/measured/
rtk proxy node "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs" render-with-measurements "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/measured" "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/measurements.json"
rtk proxy cat audit-evidence/measured/delivery-summary.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk proxy node "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs" validate "$(pwd)/audit-evidence/measured" > audit-evidence/validation.json
rtk proxy jq '"'{valid,completionAllowed,states:.coverage.states,missingChecks:.coverage.missingChecks}' audit-evidence/validation.json
rtk proxy git status --short
rtk proxy rg -n '"'^(### F|'"\\| \\*\\*Total|\\*\\*Partial)' report.md"
